title: A lookup's stored revalidation keeps only the last question's lines, so a source past its lifetime is asked again for every new question
goal: factdiff.lookup_store keeps the lines of earlier revalidations of a source still within the reuse window (merging, not replacing, rec['lines']), so a lookup that prints another fact of a source revalidated moments ago reuses the stored result instead of re-asking the source; the repro, which stores two results of one source with different lines and asks for the first, exits 0. SP-etslk6yu review (factdiff.py lookup_cached/lookup_store): Q1 prints fact A of S and stores {A}; Q2 prints B and misses, re-asks and stores {B}; Q3 prints A and re-asks again; the test replays identical lines so never hits this.

run: import sys,time; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff as f, kbcommon; f.ROOT=kbcommon.root('public'); s='S-review-etslk6yu'; n=time.time(); f.lookup_store(s,{'checked':n,'lines':{'A':{'outcome':'current'}}}); f.lookup_store(s,{'checked':n,'lines':{'B':{'outcome':'current'}}}); sys.exit(0 if f.lookup_cached(s,['A'],3600,n) else 1)
